trend: ResMed survey: 71% of Indian workers say poor sleep hurts their work, 58% say workload interferes with sleep
why: Gives a number to the exact problem Nights is built around, with a question to start replies.
text:
A ResMed survey: 71% of Indian workers say poor sleep hurts their work, and 58% say workload gets in the way of sleep.

That is the loop we built SILT Nights for: a wind-down ritual with 3 g glycine and 250 mg magnesium.

What's the one thing that wrecks your sleep on a workday?
